name: D.I.D
source:
I saw an unpleasant dream.
A dream in which there was someone covered in blood.
Present are feelings of great regret and guilt.

Even if I wake up, I can’t remember the meaning behind the dream.
Who is it?
Why is that person covered in blood?
Why is he calling for me?

I don’t know.

Not even, what my name is.

[from [url=https://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/10/28/bl-game-review-d-i-d-by-unt/]Koorin's blog[/url]]
